Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: 'North Atlantic, Rainbow Bridge', 2: 'December, 2160'}
{2: 'December 2160, North Atlantic, Rainbow Bridge.'}
{3: "The base's corridors were wet underfoot, slick with water dragged in by the survivors. Muffled groans and hushed, uneasy murmurs blended into a single thrum of dread."}

{3: "On the way to the meeting room, she accidentally stepped on the edge of a woman's clothes. The woman was curled under a thermal blanket, still trembling, the fabric dripping water onto the floor."}
{3: "But the instant Cordelia's red hair came into view, something lit up in the woman's eyes."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Mother', 3: 'Erhorn... Ms. Erhorn!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "A little girl in a red dress peeked out from her mother's embrace. It was the same mother and daughter from the VIP lounge at the port."}
{2: 'Young Mother', 3: "Could you arrange a private room for us? Ms. Erhorn, I'm your—", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Ma'am, I'm just an engineering advisor here. The private rooms are full. We had to use them for the wounded...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Mother', 3: "My daughter... she's having a fever.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The little girl's lips pressed into a pout. Her bright red dress, soaked through with seawater, had darkened to a muddy crimson."}
{3: 'Cordelia knelt down and laid a gentle hand against her forehead.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I'll find a medic.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Girl in a Red Dress', 3: 'Miss, the red got eaten by the sea... So many blue people... they all fell off... But the blue is still there... Why...', 4: '15'}
{3: 'Cordelia parted her lips to say something, but nothing came.'}
{3: 'She had no fairy tales left in her today.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}

{1: '1', 3: "When she walked into the war room, Lumi's pale, worn-out face startled her. The sea had been flooding them with distress calls all day, and the young medic trainee had been forced to double as a communications operator for the entire shift."}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "I'll go check on the girl...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Pretending to adjust her uniform, she took several long, steadying breaths. Then she pulled the door open and left. Cordelia settled into her place at the rescue communications console.'}
{3: 'The distress signals kept pouring in, one after another like an unrelenting tide.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory532.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Distress Comms', 3: '...It hurts... please, it hurts... someone... anyone...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1312.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Distress Comms', 3: "Sob... I'm so thirsty... Mom... I want to go home...", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiNoiseNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1542.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Distress Comms', 3: "Is anyone out there... anyone who can help Port Podesta? Port Podesta's already... ██ Is this the right frequency...? ██████", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(Port Podesta... What's happening on land...?)", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The stolen authority was gone. Did the fading of that power mean that Arius Erhorn, the lifelong shadow she could never shake, had already...'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(Mr. "Patriarch"... what exactly have you done?)', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Most of the distress calls from the sea were reaching their destinations, which meant the cable nodes along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge were still functioning. But beyond their own waters, there was only silence.'}
{3: "The civilian maritime bands, the military encrypted channels, the TEC's official communication lines—every frequency returned nothing."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sieg', 3: 'All units, Detachment One has docked. Standing by for survivors and wounded.', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The doors at the end of the corridor were thrown open, and a gust of sea wind carrying fine rain swept inside. The survivors lifted their hollow stares to greet yet another wave of those whom fate had spared.'}

{3: 'Time bled away to the sounds of death. The ocean dissolved into an ink-black night, the stars smothered by thick cloud. Only the base lights still held on, their glow wavering on the dark water like a shivering moon.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'All units, Detachment Three has docked. Standing by for survivors and wounded.', 4: '1'}

{3: "Boots clumped heavily, feet shuffled, and the rescue unit trudged into the corridor, wearing their exhaustion openly. The medics cut through the crowd and took the detachment's deputy captain from Onni's arms, a man so drenched in red he looked more wound than human."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: '...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: '...', 4: '2'}

{3: 'The two detachment captains stopped at the threshold of the war room, one drenched through, the other still wearing smears of unwiped blood across her face. Lyndae raised her chin just enough to look past Onni.'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Six short?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Two got cut in half. A few more dragged into the sea... We couldn't get Reyson's body back.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lyndae said nothing, her expression as blank as ever. As Onni liked to say, she always wore that deadpan look.'}
{3: 'Just before the war room doors swung open, the female lieutenant brushed against his shoulder, as if by accident, then lifted her hand and gave it a brief pat.'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: '...', 4: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'Inside the war room, exhausted eyes met equally exhausted faces, and no one said a word.'}
{3: "Over the channel, the survivors' cries for help rose yet again."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory389.jpg'}
{3: 'After the sinking of the Golden Apple, the Aden appeared to be the only remaining vessel in this vast, empty stretch of ocean.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory787.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.6'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory787.jpg'}
{2: 'Feeble Male Voice', 3: 'Help...'}
{3: "The voice from the captain's room faded into nothing and did not return."}
{3: 'Before long, a faint rustling was heard, and then a different hand, pale and slender, pressed down on the emergency comms key.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'White Stork', 3: 'This is the Aden...', 4: '1'}
{3: "White Stork kept her voice low. Reaching the captain's cabin had cost her a deep gash across her abdomen, and the blood had soaked into the baby's swaddling cloth."}
{3: "She carefully wiped a small smear of blood from the baby's cheek. Those pale golden eyes reflected nothing at all, still and vacant as a porcelain doll."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Aden, this is Rainbow Bridge Base. Can you confirm your exact coordinates—', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '18'}
{3: 'White Stork pressed her hand hard against her mouth, trapping the sob of relief before it could escape.'}
{3: 'She opened her lips to speak, and that was when she heard the footsteps.'}
{3: 'They were not human.'}
{3: 'The whir of spinning gears, the shrill shriek of metal. It was a Corrupted.'}

{3: 'White Stork looked down at the baby in her arms, despair swallowing her whole. The wound bled warmth silently into the dark, and she knew with absolute certainty that she would never walk off this ship alive.'}
{3: 'And this child could not even cry out for rescue. She felt no hunger, no cold, no fear of dying. She had never truly been born into this world.'}
{1: 'PanelActor1Shake'}
{3: "The door to the captain's cabin burst apart at her back. White Stork closed her eyes for a moment."}

{3: "Then, without a single moment's pause, she curled herself over the communication device and the infant beneath her. The air filled with the grinding scream of machinery, moonlight falling pale across her fragile shoulders."}
{3: 'In the darkness beyond that light, blood ran like a stream through that pair of golden eyes.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{3: 'Silence gripped the war room for a breath.'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "The woman's voice warped into a shriek, joined by the screech of metal and the wet sound of tearing flesh. Then the static hit, and Cordelia smashed her palm against the console key."}
{1: '1', 3: "Larsen's face had drained to a bloodless white."}
{3: 'Death might be the eternal subject of poetry and prose, but staring it in the face was the nightmare of every fragile soul.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The door swung open again. It was Sieg this time, the F.O.S. cadet, and the news he carried was not good.'}
{2: 'Sieg', 3: "...The deputy captain... didn't make it... lost too much blood, and his organs were...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'This catastrophe had surpassed every worst fear, every darkest prediction.'}
{3: 'A small sniffle escaped him as he turned away in silence, his palm clamped over his lips and nose to hold back the quivering cry.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: '...Their glory lives forever. May they rest in peace.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He paused, then spoke again in the language of his homeland.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: '...The Valkyries shall guide your way. The brave live forever in the halls.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Larsen closed his hands over his face as if granted release at last, and buried himself in them, sobbing through the verses of the heroes' elegy."}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: '"We fought with steel. I heard the ravens whisper, calling the chosen to Odin\'s hall..."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'These old poems were the stories he had heard since childhood, tales of warriors and honor and endless feasts in the golden halls.'}
{3: 'In a world reshaped by science and reason, the myths of the gods had long since faded upon their parchments.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: '"They drink deep in the great hall, golden ale raised high..."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'If death were the final, inescapable night, then bloodline and belief would always show their children where that darkness led.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Gunnar rested a firm hand on his shaking shoulder.'}
{3: 'The war room was thick with fatigue.'}
{3: 'In a hushed voice, Lumi went through the casualty figures. More than ninety had filled the base before, and now scarcely sixty remained.'}
{3: "They had prepared as thoroughly as they could once they understood the enemy's horror, yet fight after fight had still taken away faces they knew by heart."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Those things out there... we were never meant to fight them...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'We hurt. We bleed. And what do they do?! How the **** are we supposed to save anyone?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He ripped off his tactical vest and flung it hard against the floor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Onni! Not the time!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "We're just people! Human! There are things we can't do... no matter how hard we try!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'After dragging in several rough, uneven breaths, he lowered himself back into the chair.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sieg', 3: "But we've already done so much—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...He\'s right. "Human." That\'s all we are.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Cordelia propped her chin on her hand and studied the exhausted faces gathered around her.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The glorious Golden Age, the unstoppable march of human civilization... For too long it looked like humanity could achieve anything.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'But that\'s all it ever was. "It looked like."', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sieg', 3: 'But if we just do what we can... hold on to what we believe in—', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Very pretty. Right out of the textbook.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Onni, does that help at all?', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: '...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Onni let out a sigh of resignation and rose to his feet.'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Talking's useless. Let's just go. Move out.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He had barely taken the first step when he lurched violently forward.'}
{3: 'Lyndae and Sieg caught him before he could fall.'}
{3: 'With her chin still resting in her palm, Cordelia stared through the window at the dark ocean outside.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Faith doesn't have a body. Will doesn't have mass. But the ocean is vast and real. We can't save everyone. Not with what we have.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Humans were never limitless. Admitting that isn't shameful.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Onni's fist clenched hard. No one spoke."}
{1: '1', 3: "Larsen's lips quivered, and he cast a careful glance around at the others."}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Admitting we have limits... and still having to go out there... those two things aren't... they don't have to cancel each other out, do they?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'He looked at Cordelia with timid uncertainty.'}
{3: 'She showed no trace of annoyance, only winked back at him.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "With the water temperature this time of year... anyone who jumped overboard won't survive the night.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'And those voices on the comms... can we really turn away from them? To think what it cost them just to send even that much...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "We're the only hope they have.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(He's shaking like a leaf, and still trying to be someone else's hope...)", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'That heart, which had always held the world at a distance, finally stirred.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "We've lost too many... And that's not all. Medicine and food are both running low. Fresh water's going to be a serious problem soon.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: '...What exactly are we supposed to keep these people alive with? Will? Faith?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Then what do we do...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Just then, Gunnar pushed himself up from the comms station.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Larsen's right about one thing. We're their only hope. But hope doesn't mean charging out blind.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "I've listened to every distress transmission.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "I feel for those people, deeply... But right now, we have to read what's behind their words.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "The transmissions we've intercepted from Port Podesta and other coastal cities spell it out clearly: things on land are worse than here.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "And when reinforcements stop coming, this base's days are numbered.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Put bluntly, we're in the same boat as the people crying for help. It's just a question of when.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Lyndae's right. Even if we pull survivors in, can we keep them alive? Water, supplies, provisions... We're stretched thin on everything.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Every gaze in the room fell to the floor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'So we just sit here and wait to die?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Let me finish, Onni. I'm not planning on dying.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Port Podesta is the largest port in the Transatlantic Economic Community. If it's gone, the other coastal cities don't stand a chance.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Here's my assessment. Or rather... my order.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'We open all Rainbow Bridge comm channels. We become a relay station at sea.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Any ship calling for help or coming to help, we take them in. But only under strict quarantine. That virus does not set foot inside.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'We need supplies. Whatever we can scavenge during rescue ops. Every bit of it keeps us standing a little longer.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'We do what we can. But we also have to stay alive... I want that clear from the start.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Idealism won't save anyone out here. I need you all to know that.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'But... we can use practical means to serve an idealistic end.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Boss...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Now, plot the fastest route based on every confirmed distress signal.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Before the storm hits, we pull as many as we can from death's hands. Supplies too.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Those monsters are still out there. If we don't get to say goodbye before the end... then we'll meet again in Valhalla.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'So, anyone want to step back?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'No one stepped back.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '("Be realistic, demand the impossible.")', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Cordelia looked at those tired, salt-stained faces, and a tangled rush of feelings rose in her chest. There was still something in this world worth waiting for, worth believing in.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Does anyone need a break? Just for a moment?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She spoke a little more gently now.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's okay to rest. Human bodies get tired. It's just how we're built.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The soldiers traded glances among themselves.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Princess.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The weariness was gone from Onni's face."}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "We're soldiers, you know... We have to be tougher than that.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Faith was weightless, and will was no magic, yet somehow they could drive the human frame past every boundary.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Laughter broke through the room, spreading across young, exhausted faces still wet with the sea.'}
{3: 'Each one was a stubborn, brilliant flame that refused to die out.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "But I gotta have a smoke first. Can't get my head straight without one. Gotta fire up the nicotine engine.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The moment he fished a fresh cigarette from his jacket, Lumi was on her feet, the field medic in her reacting faster than words.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Absolutely not—!', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Oh, Lumi, come on!', 4: '1'}
{3: "She threaded her way through the crowd to Gunnar, smoothly taking the cigarette from Onni's hand along the way."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'You heard the doctor. She said no.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "Hmph. Ms. Erhorn's on my side now.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Nobody understands a smoker's suffering!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A single beam of light cut through the long night.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'The rescue detachment set about recalculating their route, while those staying behind gathered at the table and spread the sea chart wide.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "Active search alone won't cut it... The ocean's just too big.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sieg', 3: 'What if we light up the base at night? Make it visible and draw ships toward us!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sieg', 3: 'We can mount guide lights at the highest point. As high as possible. And line the perimeter with light strips. Turn this place into a beacon.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'All the young faces turned to Cordelia at once.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Works for me. Ms. Erhorn?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "What? Don't you all look at me. I don't do babysitting.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Fine, let's go with that.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: '...That last distress call... the one from the Aden... Will they go check on it?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sieg', 3: "But that woman sounded dead already... And the coordinates were rough. It'll probably get ruled out or... pushed way down the list.", 4: '2'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory787.jpg'}
{1: 'The Aden'}
{2: 'The Aden.'}
{3: 'She did not know why she was still alive.'}

{3: 'Her body was a ruin of wounds, her throat thick with blood and the taste of ruptured organs. The blood loss had stolen the edges from her mind, and the world before her was little more than a dark blur dotted with swimming halos of light.'}
{3: 'Thud, thud...'}
{3: "The Corrupted's footsteps echoed through the corridor, growing fainter with each step."}
{3: 'Perhaps it was because her child looked nothing like a human infant. Those golden eyes had stayed hidden beneath her body the whole time.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront32.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.9', 5: '0.7'}
{1: '1', 2: 'White Stork', 3: "(...No... I can't... not like this...)", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her hand was steeped in the warmth of her own blood. Shaking, she dragged her slick, red fingers closer to the comms button, one agonizing inch at a time.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "Are you the woman from Aden? You're alive? You're still alive?!", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Her voice was gone. The warm stream of red was carrying more of her life away into the dark.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Are you still there? Please confirm your coordinates! Help is coming!', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Hello? Aden, do you copy? Aden!', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '18'}
{3: 'The woman had no strength left to bow her head and look once more into those beautiful, vacant golden eyes.'}
{2: 'White Stork', 3: '(Cry... please, just cry...)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'White Stork', 3: "(...Let them know... you're here...)", 4: '1'}
{2: 'White Stork', 3: '(...Cry, child... please...)', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The deep red soaked slowly through the white swaddling, spreading like one last embrace from a life fading away.'}
{2: 'White Stork', 3: "(Don't... don't die here... not now... you haven't even lived yet...)", 4: '1'}
{2: 'White Stork', 3: '(Cry... cry... plea—)', 4: '1'}
{3: 'At last, the warm crimson had given every last trace of warmth it could offer. Life stopped flowing and was frozen forever in that single moment.'}
{3: 'Something that had slumbered for far too long finally stirred. Something burst open inside that small chest. A flame surged upward.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 4: '8'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Those golden eyes, kindled by blood and washed clean by fire, grew clear and bright. And now...'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 4: '8', 5: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: 'They were burning with fury.', 3: '90', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{2: 'They were burning with fury.'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory787.jpg'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront32.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.9', 5: '0.7'}

{3: 'It was the first sound she ever loosed upon the world:'}
